direction.name: Trace Web Design System
direction.rationale: Source-backed foundations and components extracted from apps/web (Base UI + Tailwind v4, shadcn base-nova style). Two accessibility overrides for review artboards: muted raised #71717a to #90909a and danger raised #ef4444 to #f87171 so muted/destructive text meets 4.5:1 AA on the #171717/#262626 surfaces.
